I did not find comparable 2024 evidence directly measuring improvements in water, sanitation, or health-service access. Education appears mainly in budgetary promises rather than in hard outcome data. So the best-supported reading is: some real welfare access improvement, but mostly via state-led stabilization and redistribution, with direct service-access evidence still
